page.layout: One page: title page. Printed lines centred in one column, with an engraved vignette (a tree with a serpent) in the middle, and the imprint below it.
page.notes: Engraving: a tree with a serpent coiled around its trunk, standing on a base, between the title lines and the imprint. The title lines are faint, and the large word INSTITVTIONVM and the lines above it show mirrored, as show-through from the reverse of the leaf; those mirrored letters are not transcribed as text. Readings of the top lines and of the imprint are doubtful and marked [?]. Stains and tears at the lower left and right edges; no page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
